annotations.title: Generate a free ServeReel content plan

description: Build a free 7 day social media content plan for a local business from its website. ServeReel reads the site, learns what the business offers, and returns a business summary plus a plan of reel, video, and image ideas tailored to its real services. Use this when a business owner wants content ideas or a posting plan and can share their website address. Planning is free and nothing is posted; making and publishing the content (videos, created images, and posts) is done by ServeReel after a free signup.
